input:
I’m trying to upload a claim document but the system says I’ve selected the wrong document category — can you help?
The user cannot upload a claim document because the system reports an incorrect document category.

We’re reviewing our upcoming renewal and need clarity on the pricing structure.
The customer does not understand the pricing structure for their upcoming renewal.

we’re missing visibility when tasks get stuck or letters go unacknowledged by policyholders
The team lacks visibility into tasks that get stuck and letters that go unacknowledged by policyholders.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — it’s not accepting my current one even though I’m certain it’s correct.
The user cannot log in because the portal rejects their correct password.

We’ve got a few things to run through today, mainly around renewals and some reporting oddities.
The customer needs to address renewals and resolve reporting inconsistencies.

Yes, it’s specifically when a reserve change exceeds handler limits — the reserve authorisation delay blocks everything until the approver returns.
Reserve authorisation delays halt claim processing when a reserve change exceeds handler limits.

Administration: click "Overview", dead x1
The Overview button in the Administration section does not work.

Also, our commercial claims team needs manual claim routing — auto-assignment breaks our complex cases.
The commercial claims team must manually route claims because automatic assignment mishandles complex cases.

we’ve got some handlers still manually moving garage estimates out of correspondence, and it’s causing delays.
Handlers have to manually move garage estimates out of correspondence, which creates delays.

Yes, that’s right. Yes, that’s right.
The customer needs confirmation that Welsh-language letters can be accessed in the templates section for the claims team.

Documents: click "Open"
Documents: click "Save", rage x3
The user struggles with inefficient document opening and saving actions.

One last thing — are the letters module and integrations with our email system still working as expected?
The customer is uncertain whether the letters module and its email system integration are still functioning correctly.

Handlers are spending too much time fixing the incorrect file type assignments — we need a better way to classify garage estimates so we don’t miss critical evidence during claims processing.
Handlers waste excessive time correcting wrong file type assignments for garage estimates.

Our commercial claims are too complex for auto-routing — we need manual claim routing for those, while motor claims can stay automated by postcode and workload.
Commercial claims are too complex to be automatically routed.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — it’s not letting me in despite multiple attempts.
The user cannot log into the claims portal despite multiple attempts.

That’s possible — we did update our supplier list last week. Could that have broken the reporting flow?
Updating the supplier list caused the reporting flow to break.

We’ve got a few workflow hiccups I’d like to flag.
The customer is experiencing workflow hiccups with the platform.

We’re still waiting on those claim progress messages to go live — the team’s keen to get policyholders auto-notified at key stages.
The claim progress notification messages have not been activated yet.

Yes, that’d be helpful — especially if we can see how reserves and payments sync with supplier updates in real time.
Inability to view real-time synchronization of reserves and payments with supplier updates.

The unexpected interface changes have forced us to retrain staff mid-cycle, which is causing errors in our claims and payments processing — we really need advance notice and bundled releases next time.
Unexpected interface changes force mid‑cycle staff retraining, leading to errors in claims and payments processing.

just wanted to flag a few things we’ve been bumping ... worth noting for your roadmap.
The customer is encountering unspecified issues that need to be addressed in the roadmap.

we’ll manage with single uploads for now and look forward to the multiple file upload improvement
Users must upload each document one at a time.

we really need claim progress messages to go out via ... to policyholders automatically.
They lack automatic claim progress notifications via SMS and email.

our finance team’s been flagging that the export figures mismatch with dashboard totals — it’s causing real delays because they can’t trust which numbers to use for month-end reporting
Exported figures do not match the dashboard totals, causing reporting delays.

Also, our finance team’s noticed the report totals differ — they’re comparing dashboard numbers with exported files and getting confused.
Finance team sees mismatched totals between the dashboard and exported reports, leading to confusion.

We keep getting error messages that say Keelwater is down, but I think it’s actually our own customer network failure — maybe the sign-on provider or our corporate VPN is interfering with the login flow.
The user receives false “Keelwater is down” errors caused by their own network or VPN interfering with login.

Also, the last update ... moved the ‘reserves’ button — we had to retrain half the team because of that.
A UI change forced the team to relearn how to use the system.

We don’t want to force one approach across all teams... Per-team configuration would solve it... prefers manual claim routing — one-size-fits-all doesn’t work for us.
The platform forces a single claim routing approach, but the commercial team needs a different, manual process.

Our team’s been unable to access Keelwater this morning — it looks like a customer login outage, but we haven’t touched our SSO setup, and it’s impacting multiple staff.
The team cannot log into Keelwater due to an unexpected login outage affecting multiple staff.

Also, can you send over a quote for adding more roles next quarter?
The customer needs a way to request a quote for adding more roles.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to figure out why my latest batch of claims documents didn’t auto-assign to the right supplier tasks.
Claims documents are not being auto-assigned to the correct supplier tasks.

That’s helpful, but we’ve had a few cases where the system choked on large batches — maybe a bug or limit?
The system fails or crashes when processing large batch uploads.

Exactly. It’s not just inconvenient — it’s holding up payments and supplier invoices too.
The approval waiting list is delaying payments and supplier invoices.

Can we push the demo to next Tuesday? I’ve got a claims audit that day and can’t reschedule... let’s start with how claims get logged.
The customer cannot attend the scheduled demo because they have a claims audit that day and there are issues with how claims are logged.

We’re experiencing a reserve authorisation delay because when a handler tries to adjust a reserve beyond their limit, it sits waiting for one specific approver who’s out of office and has no delegate assigned, so nothing moves.
Reserve adjustments get stuck because the only required approver is unavailable and has no delegate.

That’d be useful — keeps everyone informed without chasing emails.
Stakeholders need to stay informed without having to chase emails.

It’s not my login — I’ve checked the VPN and email, and it’s still happening. Feels like a customer network failure.
The user cannot access the platform despite confirming their login credentials and checking VPN and email connections.

We’re constantly phoning suppliers because there’s no live repair status, which is a daily blocker for us.
They lack live repair status updates, forcing them to repeatedly call suppliers and causing daily workflow blockages.

I’ve been reviewing the claims workflow and need to clarify how reserves tie into supplier payments.
The customer is unclear about how reserves relate to supplier payments in the claims workflow.

One last thing—can we also look at how supplier integrations work with our current policyholder data?
The customer lacks visibility into how supplier integrations operate with their existing policyholder data.

When a reserve change goes beyond what a handler can approve, it just sits there — that reserve authorisation delay has caused real issues for us, especially when the approver’s out and no one’s covering.
Reserve authorisation delays cause claims to get stuck when the approver is unavailable.

Suppliers: click "Open" ... click "Save", rage x3
Users become frustrated when trying to open and save supplier records.

We’ve noticed the proposed renewal price is higher than last year’s — can you explain how that’s calculated?... the price increase feels steep — this is a renewal price concern we need to resolve before signing off.
The customer sees the renewal price increase and doesn't understand how it's calculated, causing concern.

Appreciate the quick response — and yes, please let me know if you need any documents from our end to help troubleshoot.
The customer is unsure which documents they need to provide to help troubleshoot the issue.

Our commercial and specialty claims handlers find auto-routing unhelpful — we need manual claim routing to manage complex files properly, especially with multiple suppliers and policyholders involved.
Claims handlers find the system's auto‑routing unhelpful for complex commercial and specialty files.

That’s helpful, thanks. We’ll tweak the monitor settings for now and wait for updates on dark mode.
The platform lacks a proper dark mode, forcing users to manually adjust monitor settings.

our policyholders keep asking why they don’t get automatic updates when their claim moves to the next stage... why they aren’t getting automatic alerts when their claim status changes
Policyholders are not receiving automatic updates when their claim progresses to the next stage.

I’m having trouble with the dashboard totals not matching the CSV we export for finance.
Dashboard totals do not match the exported CSV data.

Great — glad to help improve the system.
The customer wants to ensure their feedback is properly recorded and acted upon.

Perfect. One last thing — are we able to customize the letters sent to policyholders for specific claim types?
The user cannot customize the letters sent to policyholders for different claim types.

It’s a real drag — every time we need to update a policyholder or adjust reserves, we have to interrupt our workflow ... because repair updates missing means no visibility.
Missing repair updates force the team to stop work and call suppliers, breaking their workflow.

We’ve got a claim where we need to split a payment across several payees — not sure how to handle that in the system.
The user doesn't know how to split a claim payment among multiple payees in the system.

We often need to upload files together when opening a new claim, especially when policyholders send in bundles. Right now, it’s one by one, which slows us down.
Users must upload claim documents one at a time, which is slow when many files are needed.

I’m trying to upload the latest documents for a claim under policyholder J. Whitmore, but the system won’t accept the supplier’s invoice format.
The platform rejects the supplier’s invoice format when the user tries to upload claim documents.

Our reporting team’s been waiting on those reserves ... it’s holding up the month‑end close.
The reporting team cannot complete month-end close because reserve data hasn't updated.

we’re still waiting on the document upload permissions for our policyholders’ claims portal.
The team cannot proceed because document upload permissions for the policyholders' claims portal have not been granted.

Thanks, Alwen. That’ll help us keep things clean until the system catches up.
The customer has to manually clean up duplicate loss report cases because the system doesn't automatically consolidate them.

It’s affecting how we handle reserves and policyholder updates.
The platform is disrupting their ability to manage reserves and update policyholders.

We’re still wrestling with the wrong document category issue — garage estimates keep landing in Correspondence, and our handlers have to manually move them, which risks missing critical evidence.
Documents are being mis‑categorized, forcing manual re‑classification and risking missed evidence.

Could you walk me through how to attach documents to a claim in the system? I’m not seeing the upload button on the claims tab.
User cannot find the upload button to attach documents to a claim.

I’ve been reviewing our onboarding setup and have a couple of items I’d like to flag.
The onboarding setup has issues that need to be addressed.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to get a batch of policyholder documents into a single claim — is there a way to do that without uploading each one separately?
The user has to upload each policyholder document individually, which is time‑consuming.

That’s exactly the kind of control we need...Can we schedule a demo next week to see how it handles real-time reserves updates?
They lack real-time control over reserves updates.

we’re just starting to set up our team on Keelwater and wanted to check if there’s a way to preview upcoming interface updates before they go live.
Customers cannot see upcoming interface updates before they are released.
